question: How does the practitioner’s speech change when all mantras and mudras arise?
premises: All mantras and mudras are involved
The practitioner experiences a speech change
The utterance becomes stammering or broken
inference: When all mantras and mudras manifest, the practitioner utters them in a stammering manner.
uncertainties: durdurapluta is obscure and may be a textual corruption
plain_english: He indeed utters the entire group of mantras and mudras in a stammering way.
